contractDelta: None against API Specification v2 (spec.md §API change assessment). `ReferenceLoad` already carries id, table, validFrom, status and rows; approval returns the same shape; the list endpoint returns `ListOfValues` with versions. No OpenAPI file change; this is first delivery of the three endpoints plus the rollback endpoint reused from RWB-E1-019 (CLAR-008).
backwardCompatibility: Additive; no existing endpoint changes (spec.md §API change assessment).
versioning: No API version change; the OpenAPI file is unchanged (spec.md §API change assessment).
style: ADR-RCV-001: custom REST, plain JSON, uuid ids, MSG-* error codes; no HAL, no Spring Data REST export.

endpoints.description: Load a reference-data file for a table code. Validates schema/key/business-date checks (BR2-BR6), computes SHA-256 content hash over rows sorted by key, and writes a VALIDATED reference_version plus its reference_row rows, or returns the existing load idempotently on an identical hash (CLAR-005, X4).

requestBody.shape: ReferenceLoadRequest { tableCode: string, validFrom: date, rows: array<{ rowKey: string, rowData: object }> }

responseBody.shape: ReferenceLoad { id: uuid, tableCode: string, versionNo: int, validFrom: date, status: "VALIDATED", rowCount: int, contentHash: string, loadId: uuid, rows: array<{ rowKey: string, rowData: object }> }

endpoints.authorization: Reference data C (load) — spec.md §API change assessment. RWB-E1-022 session/role mechanism not yet SUCCESS (PRE-6, Risk-2); TASK-13 checks for its RecoveryAccessGuard/role-mapping interface directly.

errors.when: Different content at an already-approved valid-from (CLAR-005).
A row fails the schema/key check (X2), naming the row and column (AC4).
Empty load file / header-only file (X7, AC10), names `rows`.

endpoints.description: Approve a VALIDATED reference_version. Refuses an approver who is also the author (X1, AC2) and uses optimistic locking so of two simultaneous approvals only one succeeds (X5, AC8). On success sets status APPROVED, approver_user_id, approved_at and the superseded version's valid_to.

requestBody.shape: ReferenceLoadApproval { } (approver identity comes from the session, not the body)

responseBody.shape: ReferenceLoad { id: uuid, tableCode: string, versionNo: int, validFrom: date, status: "APPROVED", approverUserId: uuid, approvedAt: timestamp, rowCount: int, contentHash: string, loadId: uuid, rows: array<{ rowKey: string, rowData: object }> }

endpoints.authorization: Reference data A (approve) — spec.md §API change assessment; CLAR-001 assumes RW-RISK holds it pending RWB-E1-037. RWB-E1-022 mechanism not yet SUCCESS (PRE-6, Risk-2).

errors.when: `loadId` does not resolve to a VALIDATED version.
Approver is the author, or there is no approver (X1, AC2).
Two simultaneous approvals of the same load; the later request loses the optimistic lock (X5, AC8).

endpoints.description: Read the version history (and currently-in-force version) for a table code, for admin/audit screens outside this story's scope. `listCode` is the LOV-REF-TABLE table code (data-model.md §4).

responseBody.shape: ListOfValues { listCode: string, versions: array<{ id: uuid, versionNo: int, validFrom: date, validTo: date|null, status: string, approvedAt: timestamp|null }> }

endpoints.authorization: Reference data R (read) — spec.md §API change assessment. RWB-E1-022 mechanism not yet SUCCESS (PRE-6, Risk-2).

endpoints.description: Roll back an APPROVED reference_version: same endpoint shape as the rule-rollback mechanism already recorded with RWB-E1-019 (CLAR-008). Sets status ROLLED_BACK and — per IMPL-NOTE-01 (plan.md §Risks, an inference beyond CLAR-008's endpoint-reuse answer, flagged for FDA/Technical Specifier confirmation before Builder codes it) — clears the superseded version's valid_to so the prior APPROVED version resumes being in force.

responseBody.shape: ReferenceLoad { id: uuid, tableCode: string, versionNo: int, status: "ROLLED_BACK", rows: array<{ rowKey: string, rowData: object }> }

endpoints.authorization: Reference data A (approve right governs rollback, by analogy with approve) — inferred, not individually stated in spec.md's API table; flagged alongside IMPL-NOTE-01.

errors.when: `loadId` does not resolve to any `rwb_reference_version` row at all.
`loadId` resolves to a `rwb_reference_version` row, but its status is not APPROVED.

endpoints.note: No individual SPEC-RWB-E1-043-01x ID covers rollback: spec.md's own coverage table never ties one to a BR/AC/X row (tasks.md §Requirement and spec coverage note). IMPL-NOTE-01: field-level rollback mechanics are a planner inference beyond CLAR-008's endpoint-reuse answer; not asserted as settled spec (plan.md §Risks). The 404/422 split above resolves REVIEW-RWB-E1-043-PLAN-001 (Low, plan-gate review): approved disposition Option A, Jira `TB0001-1204` comment `1783253`, 2026-11-10 — 404 is row-not-found only, 422 is row-found-wrong-status, mirroring EP-RWB-E1-043-02's existing pattern.

backendOnlyContracts.description: `ReferenceDataService.rows(tableCode, businessDate)` — the engine-facing read used by the allocation engine and other internal recovery modules to resolve the in-force version's rows for a date. No REST endpoint exists for this call (spec.md has no corresponding row in §API change assessment); TC-E1-043-01's date-based-serving half, TC-E1-043-03 (engine reads and logs once) and TC-E1-043-09/X6 (no version in force) are reachable only through this interface, not through HTTP.

coverage.decision: Backend: REQUIRED, 80% line/statement/branch/function (JaCoCo), recovery module classes only.
